fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of a master's in data science at UCL? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 deadlines.

The Data Science MSc is a **1-calendar-year**, full-time course in UCL's Department of Statistical Science, in Bloomsbury, central London (a 2-year part-time route also exists). It starts in September 2027. It is not a conversion course.

Compulsory modules are Introduction to Machine Learning, Statistical Design of Investigations, Statistical Computing, Introduction to Statistical Data Science and a Research Project. Optional modules include Graphical Models, Applied Machine Learning, Information Retrieval and Data Mining, Statistical Natural Language Processing, Applied Deep Learning and Forecasting. You program in both R and Python.

For the wider university, see our [UCL page](/study-abroad/universities/ucl).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need at least an upper second-class degree (a 2:1) in a quantitative subject, such as mathematics, statistics, economics or actuarial science. UCL expects university-level mathematical methods and linear algebra, plus some probability, statistics and programming.

**Indian marks.** UCL's India guidance asks for a bachelor's degree with a CGPA of **7.5/10**, or **60%** where no GPA scale is used. The mark you need depends on the ranking of your institution. Check the institution list on UCL's India page before you apply.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. This course needs UCL English Level 1, which means **IELTS 6.5** overall, with **6.0** in each component.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. UCL's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£48,600** a year, the fee for 2027/28 entrants.

UCL is in London, so the London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, September 2027 | £48,600 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,570 × 9 months | £14,130 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£64,452** |

The sum is £48,600 + £14,130 + £558 + £1,164 = £64,452. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule for courses in London rises from **£1,529** to **£1,570** a month for visa applications made on or after **30 November 2026**. A September 2027 student applies in 2027, so plan on **£1,570** for each month of your course, up to **9 months** (£14,130). You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row, and the 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** Overseas offer holders pay a deposit of **10%** of the first-year fee, which is **£4,860**. It counts towards tuition.

**Application fee.** UCL charges **£90** for an online application. You can apply to at most two graduate courses in a cycle.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

**UCL Global Master's Scholarship.** In the 2026/27 round this gave **£15,000** to Overseas students from lower-income backgrounds, with five awards ring-fenced for students from India. The deadline was 7 May 2026. **The 2027/28 terms are NOT CONFIRMED.** UCL has only published the 2026/27 round so far. UCL says it may be held alongside other awards, depending on their total value. See the [Global Master's Scholarship page](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/scholarships/ucl-global-masters-scholarship).

**Chevening.** Chevening, the UK government scholarship, has closed for the 2027/28 cohort. The next window opens in August 2027, for 2028 entry.

UCL lets scholarship applicants ask to delay the deposit. Do this within 1 week of your offer. Read the [UCL Computer Science scholarships page](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/engineering/computer-science/study/scholarships/postgraduate-taught-scholarships).

## Deadlines and intakes

| Intake | Who applies | Dates | Where to apply |
|---|---|---|---|
| September 2027 | Applicants who need a visa | 19 Oct 2026 to 22 Mar 2027, 5pm UK time | UCL online application |

**Indian students need a visa, so your deadline is 22 March 2027.** This is months earlier than most UK universities. UCL does not consider late applications. It aims to decide within 6 to 8 weeks of a complete application.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rule.** Make sure you meet the degree rule and have about a 7.5/10 CGPA or 60%.
2. **Prepare your documents.** You need transcripts, your degree certificate, 1 reference, your English result and a personal statement of no more than one A4 page.
3. **Apply online by 22 March 2027.** Use the Apply link on the [course page](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/study/prospective-students/graduate/courses/data-science-msc) and pay the **£90** fee.
4. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** Pay the 10% deposit within 4 weeks. The university then issues your CAS. A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the electronic letter your visa application needs.
5. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
6. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.
- **Careers.** The course prepares you for specialist statistics and data roles, or academic research.

## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- your degree is in maths, statistics, economics or another quantitative subject
- you can apply early, by **22 March 2027**
- you want to study in central London and can budget about £64,452 for the first year

**Think carefully if:**

- your maths is weak, because the course expects university-level linear algebra
- your budget is tight, because London fees and living money make this one of the costliest choices

faq_json.q: Is the UCL MSc Data Science a conversion course?
faq_json.a: No. You need a 2:1 in a quantitative subject, with university-level maths and some programming.

faq_json.q: How much does the UCL MSc Data Science cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £48,600 for 2027/28. With London visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the year comes to £64,452.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Applicants who need a visa must apply by 22 March 2027, 5pm UK time. UCL does not consider late applications.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need?
faq_json.a: UCL asks for a CGPA of 7.5/10 or 60%, depending on the ranking of your institution.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score does UCL need?
faq_json.a: Level 1: IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each component. The course page does not mention GRE.
